title: Long-term exploratory evaluation of an acellular biomimetic polyfascicular nerve guidance conduit for peripheral nerve repair in a rhesus macaque model

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Long-term exploratory evaluation of an acellular biomimetic polyfascicular nerve guidance conduit for peripheral nerve repair in a rhesus macaque model》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Peripheral nerve injury (PNI) affects millions worldwide, yet currently approved nerve guidance conduits (NGCs) have limited ability to recapitulate the native fascicular architecture that supports organized axonal regeneration.
